operating_objective_input.provenance_quote: i feel like this list of what the system should do needs to be included in the roadmap. that really makes it clear what the objectives are
operating_objective_input.cutover_question: Can Joe or Dell now complete and understand this routine without opening Claude Code or Codex?
objectives: Understand business and system state visually within seconds.
Perform routine work through straightforward controls.
Ask Doc for clarification without starting an engineering session.
See what agents are doing, which agent is acting, current phase, exact scope, and why.
Approve consequential changes through clear, exact action cards.
Queue improvements for Claude Code or Codex without supervising the entire build conversation.
Receive verified outcomes, evidence, blockers, and history back in the interface.
Open a heavy Claude Code or Codex session only when exploring, investigating a genuinely complex problem, or constructing something new.
baseline_measures_without_invented_value: Joe’s current weekly time spent using heavy AI sessions for routine system/business operation
Count and categories of routine questions that require Claude/Codex explanation
Count and categories of recurring actions that cannot be completed visually
Median time to determine business state and system health
Number of hand-carried context transfers between sessions
council_criteria: Require instrumentation or interview before baseline values exist
Bind every baseline to a product action and a like-for-like post-launch comparison
Do not treat heavy AI use for exploration, complex investigation, or new construction as a product failure
Do not retire a routine surface until the exact cutover question is answered yes by uncoached evidence

current_evidence_inputs.finding: Canonical shared checkout was dirty and diverged; local main was ahead 15 and behind 14 with unrelated modified and untracked work.
current_evidence_inputs.implication: Use isolated worktrees, preserve unrelated work, and do not treat the shared checkout as release truth.

current_evidence_inputs.finding: Fresh origin/main baseline verified at commit 44354896e4bfe3eb5250290407cb955a1c10d253.
current_evidence_inputs.implication: Reconcile deliberate work from an isolated branch against the reviewed integration baseline.

current_evidence_inputs.finding: The live patch-deal-field path produced an internal error during the Myrick parking attempt described in the BDUF.
current_evidence_inputs.implication: Treat parking write production release as blocked until reproduced, fixed, and freshly verified through the Cloudflare record-verb path.

current_evidence_inputs.finding: No .github/workflows directory existed in the inspected baseline.
current_evidence_inputs.implication: Establish required PR CI before production expansion; do not claim CI coverage today.

current_evidence_inputs.finding: Fresh live registry observation reported 91 deployed verbs, 67 write verbs, and no Workspace product API routes.
current_evidence_inputs.implication: Phase 0 contracts are proposals; verify exact current verbs again before construction.

current_evidence_inputs.finding: Sanctioned production migration dry run reported 99 applied and 0 pending.
current_evidence_inputs.implication: This is current read-only evidence, not authority to migrate.

current_evidence_inputs.finding: Fresh nightly probe observed health HTTP 200, anonymous MCP HTTP 401 on both hosts, and 64 of 64 views queryable.
current_evidence_inputs.implication: Re-run the sanctioned probe and route-level live read-back at release time; no current result proves future deployment behavior.

current_evidence_inputs.finding: OAuth/KV writes resumed after the documented daily quota outage; dynamic client registration returned HTTP 201 and standing context returned live data.
current_evidence_inputs.implication: Availability is restored but capacity design remains open until write sources and headroom are measured.

settled_inputs.decision: The Command Center is home; primary modules are Command Center, Leads, Deals, Calls, Marketing, and More.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: uncoached prototype evidence shows a material navigation failure

settled_inputs.decision: Front Door retires as a primary interface; only three measured high-frequency flows may graduate.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: usage inventory proves a broader launcher is essential

settled_inputs.decision: Doc is contextual and governed; it has no unrestricted partner authority and no send, publish, spend, identity-merge, ownership-change, or deploy path.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: never for convenience; requires a new explicit security decision

settled_inputs.decision: Exactly one persistent Call Mode control; calls retain structured outcomes and agent work history, not a transcript library.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: actual-device evidence requires a layout refinement without duplicating authority or capture

settled_inputs.decision: Sequence is website, Mac parity shell after website completion, iPhone voice-first, then iPad Pencil-first Tour Mode.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: Joe explicitly changes product sequencing after council

settled_inputs.decision: Google route optimization supports locked appointments; CARR owns a native Tour Notebook; Goodnotes is optional share interoperability.
settled_inputs.reopen_only_if: supported APIs materially change and evidence proves a safer reliable integration

settled_inputs.decision: Neon-backed records are canonical; Salesforce is provenance/upstream paperwork; all UI and exported artifacts are projections.
